commit: feat(api): accept a URL as ignorePath in getFileInfo()

truth.description: createIsIgnoredFunction now throws a TypeError for every ignore file that is not a string or URL, but getFileInfo wraps the options.ignorePath it holds into an array even when it is missing and passes that [undefined] on through isIgnored, so every prettier.getFileInfo() call without an ignorePath rejects instead of reporting the file.

distractions.why: fs.readFile takes a string as a path even when it starts with file:, so a URL string has to become a URL object before the read, while a URL object passes through unchanged.
